Kabhi socha SBI, HDFC jaise bank
Aapne bank mein ₹1 lakh deposit kiye.
Bank aapko saal ka deta hai lagbhag 2.5% —
Phir bank yahi paisa home loan pe udhaar deta hai,
Yahi difference bank ko ek moti kamai karke deta hai —
aur ye sirf aapke ek lakh pe.
Ab crore logon ka paisa socho!
Aur agar wahi paisa credit card pe gaya,
aur bill time pe nahi bhara?
Isliye credit card ka bill hamesha poora bharo…
warna aap bank ki sabse moti kamai ban jaoge.
